summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an equity purchase agreement with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC for up to $15 million of common stock via put notices. This is a structured equity facility, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other event-based catalyst exists. The terms describe a variable-priced standby agreement with discount pricing at 92% of market. There is no board recommendation or advisor, and no deal mechanics beyond standard conditions. The filing is routine financing, thus not categorized under any special situation category.
